input: nums is a plain list of plain int values, excluding bool, with 0 <= len(nums) <= 10 and all values in [-9007199254740991, 9007199254740991]. All values are pairwise distinct. Subclasses and concurrent mutation are excluded. Preconditions are not checked at runtime. The bounded length limits recursive helper depth to n + 1 <= 11 live calls; unbounded recursion or output capacity is not claimed.
return: A fresh list of fresh list subsets, including one empty subset first. Every subset of the n distinct input values appears exactly once. Values within each subset retain input order; subsets are emitted by depth-first increasing-input-index traversal, recording each path before extending it. Empty input returns a one-element outer sequence containing a fresh empty sequence. The output sequence is deterministic and must agree exactly between these paired candidates on their shared domain, independently of order-insensitive problem acceptance.
mutation_aliasing: The input list, its order and all entries remain unchanged. Each returned subset is a fresh shallow copy of the temporary path, and all elements are immutable integers. The outer result, each inner subset, nums and the temporary path are distinct mutable containers; no returned subset aliases another. Mutating one returned subset cannot change any other subset or the input. The Solution instance retains no state, and separate calls share no mutable result state.
numeric: The shared length bound is 0 <= n <= 10, and each value is an integer in [-9007199254740991, 9007199254740991]. Values are copied, not arithmetically transformed; indices, depth and index + 1 remain exact safe integers. Python arbitrary-size integers do not broaden the paired value domain. The exact output count is 2^n <= 1024 subsets, interpreted mathematically rather than computed by the candidate.
complexity: For n = input length, Theta((n + 1)*2^n) time and retained-output space including every copied subset, container and element slot. There are 2^n subset containers and, for n >= 1, n*2^(n-1) stored integer slots; n = 0 still returns one container. Auxiliary path plus recursive stack use O(n + 1) space, excluding retained output. Index-monotone choose/recurse/undo explores each subset once, and copying the path prevents output aliasing. No sorting or input writes occur.

helpers.name: collect
helpers.contract: A per-call recursive closure over nums, path and subsets. Record a shallow path copy, then choose each remaining index in increasing order, recurse from index + 1 and undo with pop. The start index makes each subset correspond to exactly one increasing index sequence.
helpers.cost: The complete nested helper definition is 234 UTF-8 bytes, including its indentation and terminal newline, and is charged in this standalone source. All invocations, copy operations, loop scans and push/pop updates are included in the stated output-sensitive cost; maximum live recursive depth is n + 1.
